items.text: Meshy demonstrated clean cel-shaded 3D rendering in Blender driven by its 8K generated textures.
items.text_zh: Meshy 演示用其生成的 8K 贴图在 Blender 中实现干净的赛璐璐风格三维渲染。

items.text: Recraft shipped V4.1, showcasing jewelry renders with physically convincing glass refraction and depth across rings, earrings and collars.
items.text_zh: Recraft 发布 V4.1，展示戒指、耳环、颈饰等珠宝渲染中物理可信的玻璃折射与景深表现。

items.text: Shanghai AI Lab's InternLM introduced Visual Pretraining, a scalable paradigm letting foundation models learn directly from rendered visual documents.
items.text_zh: 上海人工智能实验室书生 InternLM 提出 Visual Pretraining，一种让基础模型直接从视觉文档中学习的可扩展预训练范式。

items.text: Apple detailed the audio detokenizer behind Siri Expressive Voices: decoupled temporal-depth diffusion streaming at ~21MB peak memory, 16x faster than real time, +0.28 MOS.
items.text_zh: 苹果公开 Siri 表现力语音背后的音频解码器：时间-深度解耦扩散架构，峰值内存约 21MB、速度达实时的 16 倍，MOS 提升 0.28。

items.text: An engineering writeup claims a $500 reinforcement-learning fine-tune of a 9B open model beat frontier models on a product-catalog review task.
items.text_zh: 一篇工程复盘称，花 500 美元对 9B 开源模型做强化学习微调，在商品目录审核任务上击败了前沿模型。

items.text: Simon Willison published an opinionated guide mapping which AI tool to reach for across common everyday tasks.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 发布主观指南，梳理日常各类任务分别该选用哪款 AI 工具。

items.text: Satya Nadella warned that companies betting everything on a single AI provider may not survive, urging multi-model strategies.
items.text_zh: 纳德拉警告：把全部业务押在单一 AI 供应商上的公司可能活不下来，呼吁企业采用多模型策略。

items.text: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna xHigh variants entered Agent Arena at #15 and #17, well behind sibling Sol, which ranks top two.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Terra 与 Luna（xHigh）进入 Agent Arena，分列第 15、17 名，远落后于同门 Sol 的前二成绩。

items.text: Cursor added Kimi K3, saying it scores close to the frontier on CursorBench and runs on US-based inference from Fireworks, Together, and Baseten.
items.text_zh: Cursor 上线 Kimi K3，称其 CursorBench 成绩接近前沿模型，并通过 Fireworks、Together、Baseten 提供美国本土推理。

items.text: Users found publicly shared Claude chats and Artifacts indexed by Google, exposing conversations people assumed were only link-accessible.
items.text_zh: 用户发现公开分享的 Claude 对话和 Artifacts 被谷歌收录，原本以为只能凭链接访问的内容遭曝光。

items.text: OpenAI published research on small businesses finding staff increasingly use ChatGPT to handle work outside their own job descriptions.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 发布小微企业研究，发现员工越来越多地用 ChatGPT 处理本职之外的工作。

items.text: LMArena added a factuality ranking blending human preference with factual accuracy, where Claude Opus 5 with Max reasoning takes the #1 Text Arena spot.
items.text_zh: LMArena 新增结合人类偏好与事实准确度的 factuality 榜，Claude Opus 5（Max 推理）登顶文本竞技场第一。

items.text: Verizon signed a roughly $1 billion dark fiber deal to connect Google data centers, calling it the first of many AI-driven contracts.
items.text_zh: Verizon 签下约 10 亿美元暗光纤协议连接谷歌数据中心，称这只是 AI 驱动订单的开始。

items.text: Moonshot released PerceptionBench, a benchmark that isolates visual perception and scores it as a set of atomic capabilities derived from real model failures.
items.text_zh: 月之暗面发布 PerceptionBench，将视觉感知单独剥离出来，按从真实模型失败中归纳的原子能力逐项评测。

items.text: Microsoft launched an agentic cybersecurity system alongside its first in-house cyber model, automating triage and investigation workflows.
items.text_zh: 微软在推出首个自研网络安全模型的同时发布智能体安全系统，自动化告警分诊与调查流程。

items.text: A judge rejected Google's attempt to use DMCA claims against a web scraper, with the winning company declaring that Google and Reddit "do not own the Internet."
items.text_zh: 法官驳回谷歌以 DMCA 条款起诉网页抓取公司的主张，胜诉方称谷歌和 Reddit "并不拥有互联网"。

items.text: Together AI became a day-zero launch partner for Kimi K3, offering immediate high-throughput developer access to the model.
items.text_zh: Together AI 成为 Kimi K3 的 day0 首发合作伙伴，为开发者提供即时的高吞吐调用。

items.text: OpenAI rolled GPT-Live in ChatGPT Voice out globally to Edu, Business, and Enterprise plans.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 将 ChatGPT Voice 中的 GPT-Live 全球开放给教育版、商业版和企业版用户。

items.text: ChatGPT now refuses direct requests to write in a named living author's style, though testers say it still reproduces a similar feel indirectly.
items.text_zh: ChatGPT 开始拒绝直接模仿指定在世作家文风的请求，但测试者称绕个弯仍能写出相似味道。

items.text: Meta opened Threads direct messages to Meta AI, letting users chat with the assistant inside their DM inbox.
items.text_zh: Meta 向 Threads 私信开放 Meta AI，用户可直接在私信收件箱中与助手对话。

items.text: LlamaIndex released create-llama-worker, a scaffold that deploys a LlamaParse document-parsing worker to Cloudflare Workers in minutes.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 发布 create-llama-worker 脚手架，几分钟即可把 LlamaParse 文档解析 worker 部署到 Cloudflare Workers 边缘。

items.text: Perplexity shipped pplx, a single-binary CLI exposing only web search and page fetch as strict JSON, built for coding agents rather than chat.
items.text_zh: Perplexity 推出单文件 CLI 工具 pplx，只提供网页搜索与正文抓取两条命令并严格输出 JSON，专为编程 Agent 而非聊天设计。

items.text: New data shows Google's AI-generated search results are rapidly becoming the default experience for most queries.
items.text_zh: 最新数据显示，谷歌的 AI 搜索结果正迅速成为多数查询的默认体验。

items.text: Cognition added Kimi K3 to Devin Desktop and CLI, saying it scores 58.2% on FrontierCode 1.1 Extended with a 63.6% pass rate.
items.text_zh: Cognition 已将 Kimi K3 接入 Devin 桌面端和 CLI，称其在 FrontierCode 1.1 Extended 上得分 58.2%、通过率 63.6%。

items.text: PixVerse upgraded the speech engine inside its Avatar Lip Sync Mini App for more natural talking-head video.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 升级了 Avatar Lip Sync 小应用中的语音引擎，使数字人口播视频更自然。

items.text: PixVerse added Depth Map control to its Mini Apps, letting creators drive image-to-video motion with a grayscale depth video extracted from a reference clip.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 在 Mini Apps 中上线深度图控制，创作者可用参考视频提取的灰度深度序列驱动图生视频的运镜与运动。

items.text: Kling published a tutorial for producing a full beauty-clinic ad end to end through its MCP server, from concept to finished cut.
items.text_zh: 可灵发布教程，演示如何通过其 MCP 服务从概念到成片完整制作一支医美诊所广告。
